findings.description: The detail page with both routes connected is not drawn. It would carry two Disconnect buttons (MCP card, key card) with different effects: the MCP one signs out of Granola, the key one stops sync and keeps stored meetings. Nothing tells them apart.
findings.expected: The journey step has a drawn, unambiguous surface.
findings.actual: The detail page with both routes connected is not drawn. It would carry two Disconnect buttons (MCP card, key card) with different effects: the MCP one signs out of Granola, the key one stops sync and keeps stored meetings. Nothing tells them apart.
findings.suggested_fix: Draw a 'Both connected' frame and label the buttons or the cards so the effects are distinguishable (for example the key card's sentence 'Rakazo keeps your meetings and to-dos.' appears only after its Disconnect).
